## SaaS GTM Team Architecture

Building a SaaS go-to-market team requires careful sequencing. Hire the wrong role at the wrong stage and you spend money without generating pipeline. This guide quotes no salary, quota or benchmark figures, because we have not cited a source for any.

### GTM Hire Sequence by Stage

*The stages and hires below are a rule of thumb for illustration. Adjust them to your product and motion.*

| Stage | GTM priority hires |
|---|---|
| Very early | Founder-led sales, a product marketer |
| Finding repeatability | A few AEs and SDRs, a demand generation marketer |
| Building the team | Sales leadership, a customer success team, a marketing manager |
| Scaling | A revenue leader, solutions engineers, RevOps |
| Expansion | Regional and enterprise segment teams, a marketing leader |
| Large scale | A full GTM organization specialized by geography and segment |

### SaaS-Specific Roles

**Hiring in SaaS?**

[See how TaaSFlow works for saas hiring](/industries/saas)

| Role | What they do | When to consider hiring |
|---|---|---|
| Product marketing manager | Positioning, launches, competitive intelligence | After product-market fit |
| Customer success manager | Retention, expansion, adoption | When you have enough customers to need dedicated coverage |
| Solutions engineer | Pre-sales technical support | When deals are technical or you have several AEs |
| Revenue operations | Data, tools, process optimization | When GTM systems need an owner |
| Demand generation | Pipeline creation through marketing | When you want repeatable inbound |
| Growth marketer | Product-led growth, experiments | Product-led companies |
| Partner manager | Channel and partner revenue | When partners become a meaningful channel |

### SaaS Compensation Structures

Most GTM roles combine a base salary with variable pay. What changes is how much of the package is variable and what it is tied to.

| Role | Variable pay tied to |
|---|---|
| AE | New bookings, and expansion in enterprise |
| CSM | Retention and expansion |
| SE | Aligned with the AEs they support |
| SDR | Meetings and pipeline generated |
| RevOps | Mostly base, with company performance |

Set base and variable splits from a current, named compensation source for your market.

### Key SaaS Metrics by Role

| Role | Primary metric |
|---|---|
| AE | Annual contract value, quota attainment |
| SDR | Pipeline generated |
| CSM | Net revenue retention |
| SE | Win rate on supported deals |
| Product marketing | Content-influenced pipeline |
| Demand generation | Marketing-sourced pipeline |

Set targets from your own history, not from a number in a blog post.

### PLG vs. Sales-Led Hiring

| Dimension | Product-led growth | Sales-led growth |
|---|---|---|
| First GTM hire | Growth marketer or engineer | Account executive |
| Sales involvement | Self-serve until enterprise | Immediately |
| CS focus | Product adoption, low-touch | Relationship, high-touch |
| Marketing focus | In-product, virality, SEO | Outbound, events, content |
| RevOps focus | Product analytics plus revenue | CRM and pipeline management |
